annotations.annotation_text: Page 417 opens Book 3, Chapter 1 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)") during the Age of Men phase. This passage continues Shaun floating down the Liffey in a barrel, delivering his sermon, the well-fed postman who delivers messages he cannot understand, featuring Shaun, Issy, the Rainbow Girls. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.

annotations.annotation_text: Viconian marker "vico" on page 417 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)"): Giambattista Vico's cyclical philosophy — divine, heroic, and human ages followed by thundering ricorso — structures this passage within Shaun floating down the Liffey in a barrel, delivering his sermon, the well-fed postman who delivers messages he cannot understand. The current Age of Men phase shapes the language, institutional imagery, and historical echoes of the dream.
sources: Beckett, Samuel. Dante... Bruno. Vico.. Joyce. https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic node on page 417 ("Shaun the Post (First Watch)"): Joyce weaves multilingual puns across 60+ languages — etymological roots from the Contemporary Literature Press lexicons (Romanian, Scandinavian, Slavic, Classical) intersect with local Dublin speech rhythms. The Age of Men dream-logic transforms ordinary syntax into a palimpsest of global literary and mythic references.
